subject: [PATCH] memcg: bypass the reclaim and oom killer for dying tasks once oom_reaper is done

2026-07-30.patch_summary: This patch prevents the reclaim and OOM killer from interfering with dying tasks once oom_reaper has finished its work. The problem it solves is that dying tasks can get stuck in the exit path for hours due to slow serialization behind the oom_lock, causing thousands of threads to wait on the lock and resulting in a deadlock. The approach taken is to bypass the reclaim and OOM killer for dying tasks once oom_reaper has completed its task, allowing the memory to be freed asynchronously.
